title: All-q unsigned apartment visibility kernel and spectral lift
purpose: Lift the q=3 BT546 unsigned 3-adic overlap kernel to every GQ(q,q): derive B B^T=q^4A0+q^3A1+q^2A2+qA3+A4 for unsigned flag-edge/apartment incidence, diagonalize it on the all-q flag distance scheme, and recover the exact W33 spectrum 648, 144±36sqrt6, 72, 40 with multiplicities 1,24,24,30,81.

targets.5404: unsigned apartment overlap kernel by distance

boundary: This is the spectrum of the full unsigned apartment-incidence Gram matrix. Do not reinterpret it as the signed Hodge projector, and do not infer contextuality degree, quantum-code distance, or physical noise tolerance without a separate theorem.
